notes.built: Every decoy now fades in and out the whole way in, from its launch (1.6 beats a second, from full down to 15% and back, a pale halo at the top of each beat), in every swarm, pair and event; the steel-blue tint stays. The bots read a decoy from launch. Decoy Storm got easy with it, so it now sends twelve swarms (ten), the second half 2 s sooner (round 9).

notes.text: The good command did not work at all
notes.built: Bug fixed. The press was accepted but changed nothing on the water: Hold only kept back the groups that came due while it was on, off the map, and the next one was 5.2 s away (it sailed 0.7 s late). Hold now stops every ship short of the hold line where it is, within 0.4 s; the line is drawn on the water and pulses while Hold is on, each held ship carries a pause mark, the button beats and reads Release / HOLDING n, and a refused press says why beside the button (round 9, convoy rules rev 2).
